I know this pattern, the land suits it, the machines and inputs are easy to find, and it spreads my work across the year. I will not choose crops that need too much hand labor or close technical management. I will use improved seed rather than risky expensive seed, keep fertilizer at a moderate level, irrigate only at key times because water matters, and control pests only when needed. For tillage, I will mainly use rotary tillage because it is easier for me to manage than deep ploughing every time, and it fits this rotation. My goal is steady grain, lower risk, and work I can still handle at my age.
